repos_data.description: A curated list of tools, data sources, libraries, and resources for working with SEC filings (13F, 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K)
Free CC0 point-in-time US fundamentals proof pack — 5 companies, 225 annual rows across their latest 3 fiscal years, full methodology, no signup.
Tracker for U.S. public-company equity stakes in Anthropic and OpenAI. Built from primary SEC filings, court records, and press releases. Each row confidence-tagged (V/P/S).
Invert a stock price into the bet it implies: the growth, duration, and margin a price assumes. Textbook expectations-investing reverse DCF over SEC EDGAR filings. No price targets, no ratings.
Extract geographic revenue breakdowns from SEC EDGAR 10-K filings. Pure Python, no API key.
Eleven ways SEC filing data lied to me, each with the bug report that found it. No dependencies.

CI for investment theses: write the tests that would prove a thesis wrong in YAML, lint a research archive so every number cites a filing and public files carry no valuation or advice, freeze each quarter's thresholds once results are out, and Brier-score forecasts. Python CLI and GitHub Action. 中文版: zh-CN/
SEC/EDGAR financial filings API for AI agents — pay per query in USDC via x402

MCP server for the Filingrail SEC EDGAR API — company financials, insider trades, 8-K events, 13F holdings, and filings for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Continue, and any MCP agent. pip install filingrail-mcp
MCP server exposing SEC EDGAR filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K) as agent tools - pay-per-call in USDC on Base via x402. No API key, no signup.
Python SEC EDGAR full-text search (efts.sec.gov) to CSV, no API key; date-splitting gets past the 10,000-result cap. MIT.
